scenarios.scenario_abstract: Under a restrictive stadium bag policy, [X] reduces the carried load to a phone, card, and stripped-down car key, assigns them to closed on-body compartments, and tests the setup through security, recording, dancing, dense crowds, and the walk back to parking.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在严格的体育场限包规定下，[X]把随身物精简为手机、卡片和拆去多余挂件的车钥匙，分别放进可闭合的贴身收纳处，并在安检、录像、舞动、拥挤人群和步行返车的全过程中检验这套安排。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While cleaning, painting, and emptying an old home in chronological stages, [X] keeps a phone, keys, marker, tape, and one small tool in separate on-body positions so both hands can move boxes and supplies without repeatedly abandoning the task to search for essentials.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按时间顺序清洁、粉刷旧居并搬运物品时，[X]把手机、钥匙、记号笔、胶带和一件小工具分开放在贴身位置，让双手能够持续搬纸箱和清洁用品，不必反复中断任务寻找必需品。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After once losing a document bag in Paris, [X] leaves backup cash and cards at the hotel and consolidates the passport, phone, and daily payment card in one closed front-worn carrier, deliberately avoiding any secondary on-body storage that could be forgotten or exposed in crowded transit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 曾在巴黎丢失证件袋后，[X]把备用现金和卡片留在酒店，并将护照、手机和当日支付卡集中放进一个前背的封闭随身件，同时刻意不设其他贴身收纳位置，避免在拥挤公共交通中遗忘或暴露物品。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a weeklong July hike, [X] assigns a route note, whistle, phone or beacon, gloves, and one snack to closed on-body positions that remain reachable in bad weather without removing the main pack, then rehearses each retrieval with the pack fully loaded.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 规划七月一周徒步时，[X]把路线记录、哨子、手机或信标、手套和一份零食分别放进恶劣天气下无需卸主背包也能取用的可闭合贴身位置，并在背包满载时逐一演练取用。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When first trying easy local-park geocaches, [X] gives the phone, logbook pen, and one tiny trade item separate quick-access positions on the body, moving among GPS checks, discreet searching, signing, and exchange without setting the tools down or mixing them together.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 初次尝试本地公园的低难度地理寻宝时，[X]把手机、日志笔和一件小型交换物分别放在可快速取用的贴身位置，在查看 GPS、低调搜索、签写和交换之间切换时无需放下工具，也不会把它们混在一起。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To make laundry and trash easier to start, [X] runs short timed chore bursts but leaves the phone at one fixed audible station before lifting a basket or tied bag, keeping clothing unburdened and returning to the same place only when the timer ends.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了更容易开始洗衣和倒垃圾，[X]采用短时家务冲刺，但在提起洗衣篮或扎好的垃圾袋前，会把手机留在一个能听见提示的固定位置，让衣物保持无负担，并只在计时结束后回到同一位置。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While quietly preparing to leave an unsafe home, [X] keeps identification, bank access, essential contacts, and a protected phone together in one grab-ready document bag, avoiding distribution across clothing so the complete critical set can leave at once without a visible final search.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 低调准备离开不安全的家庭环境时，[X]把身份证件、银行访问方式、关键联系人和受到保护的手机统一放进一个随时可带走的证件袋，不把它们分散到衣物中，从而能一次带走完整核心物品，无需在最后进行显眼搜寻。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a long-distance move mostly by public transport, [X] keeps tickets, identification, phone, medication, and first-night essentials in one guarded personal item that never enters the luggage rack, placing nothing critical in secondary on-body locations during transfers.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 主要依靠公共交通进行长途搬迁时，[X]把票据、证件、手机、药物和首夜必需品集中在一个从不放上行李架、始终看护的随身件中，换乘时不把任何关键物品分散到其他贴身位置。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a budget beach day with a sister and mother, [X] keeps all valuables out of secondary on-body storage because swimming, sand, sunscreen, and wet fabric make those locations unreliable; everything remains together in one waterproof dry pouch watched by the group and opened only at deliberate stops.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与姐姐和母亲进行预算有限的海滩一日游时，[X]不把贵重物分散到其他贴身收纳位置，因为游泳、沙粒、防晒用品和湿布料会让这些位置变得不可靠；所有贵重物统一放进由同行者看管的防水干燥袋，只在有意识停下时开启。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a five-mile city bicycle commute, [X] moves the heavy work bag to a rear rack but keeps the phone, access card, and keys in closed on-body positions that remain stable while pedaling and can be reached after stopping to lock the bicycle in wet weather.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 每天骑行五英里城市道路通勤时，[X]把较重的工作包移到后货架，但把手机、门禁卡和钥匙放在踩踏时保持稳定、雨天停车上锁后可取用的可闭合贴身位置。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A bicycle food courier working in a high-theft neighborhood abandons an exposed handlebar phone mount, adopts one-earbud voice navigation with the main phone zipped out of sight, pulls over before checking orders, and keeps power, food, lock, and repair gear on separate bike-mounted storage systems.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名在高盗窃风险街区工作的自行车外卖骑手放弃暴露在车把上的手机支架，改用单耳语音导航并把主手机拉链封闭、藏在视线外，只在靠边停车后查看订单，同时把电源、餐食、车锁和维修工具分配到独立的车载储物系统。
